articles.title: Finnish watchmaker Kari Voutilainen’s limited-edition steel watch sells for $1.016 million at auction
articles.description: At a recent Phillips auction, an exquisite stainless-steel timepiece crafted by renowned watchmaker Kari Voutilainen commanded an impressive $1.016 million, far surpassing its estimated value. The Voutilainen 28Sport Limited Edition features a stunning blue guilloché dial complemented by a striking black onyx center. Originally acquired in 2021, this watch's sale underscores the increasing allure of exceptional and rare watches within the collector community.

articles.title: Portland man turns $48,412 backyard makeover into $85,000 rental business
articles.description: Rob Nachbar skillfully turned his once-simple backyard in Portland into a thriving rental space known as Pong Springs. This five-year renovation, which cost $48,412, prioritized weather-resistant structures and enhanced privacy features. Since its launch on Swimply, Nachbar has generated approximately $106,000 in revenue. The yard not only hosts various events but also provides the family with a serene private retreat—combining leisure and financial success.

articles.title: Sam Altman outlines three possible futures for AI, calls compute monopoly ‘terrible’
articles.description: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman has outlined three possible futures for artificial intelligence, including an international watchdog modelled on the IAEA, a unified AI research organisation, and a scenario in which one company gains overwhelming computing power to eliminate competitors. According to The Latin Times, the discussion reflects growing concerns over AI safety, regulation and competition. Meanwhile, major AI developers are reportedly exploring an industry-led oversight body, highlighting the challenge of balancing rapid innovation with accountability and global cooperation.
